    <h1>ADALab</h1>
    <p class="lead">We are a research group focused on <strong>Systems Immunology, Proteomics, and Cancer Biology</strong>, with a strong emphasis on mechanistic discovery, biomarker development, and translational core services.</p>

  <div class="hero-panel">
    <h3>Core capabilities</h3>
    <ul>
      <li>LC-MS/MS and GC-MS workflows</li>
      <li>MALDI imaging and spatial omics</li>
      <li>Multiplex biomarker analysis</li>
      <li>Proteomics and metabolomics data integration</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="info-grid">
  <article class="info-card">
    <h3>Research focus</h3>
    <p>We investigate how viral infection, immune regulation, and cancer biology intersect across molecular, cellular, and systems levels.</p>
  </article>

  <article class="info-card">
    <h3>Core services</h3>
    <p>Our work supports discovery and validation pipelines for biomarker identification, tissue imaging, and high-throughput omics analysis.</p>
  </article>

  <article class="info-card">
    <h3>Collaboration</h3>
    <p>We partner with investigators across oncology, immunology, and translational science to accelerate discovery and application.</p>
  </article>
</section>
